description: SOM Flood Prone Areas - Merge of Flood Extent 2013-2023 is a hazard data set listed in SODMA open data portal (Somalia and Greater Horn of Africa disaster risk data), a disaster risk data portal, published or maintained by SWALIM. This is a merge of historical flood extents. See "SOM Juba Shabelle River Floods" layers: Deyr 2023, Gu 2021, Gu 2020, Hagaa 2020, Gu 2019, Deyr 2019, Gu 2018, Deyr 2018, Gu 2016, Gu 2015, Deyr 2013. Coverage: Africa (the listing does not name one country). The portal files it under the publisher SWALIM. Its tags are floods, prone, somalia. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, PNG. The portal shows 2025-06-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sodma-somalia-disaster-risk-data-portal.
